JASON A. HOWTON'S NOTICE OF ERRORS IN APPLICANTS' PROPOSED ORDER
    OF PRESENTATION AND REQUEST FOR CORRECTION AT PREHEARING
                                         CONFERENCE

                                       I. INTRODUCTION

On June 3, 2026, Applicants filed their Notice of Compliance with Prehearing Submission
Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23 (Item No. 5755), attaching as Attachment 2 a
proposed order of presentation grouping intervenors by route segment. Intervenor Jason A.
Howton files this notice to identify two confirmed placement errors that directly affect him and
one other F20 intervenor, and to bring to the presiding officers' attention several additional
apparent errors affecting other F20 and F22/F23 intervenors. Mr. Howton requests that the
Administrative Law Judges direct Applicants to correct Attachment 2 at or before the Prehearing
Conference scheduled for June 8, 2026.

                          II. ERRORS REQUIRING CORRECTION

A. Jason A. Howton Misplaced at Link R1


                     HOWTON NOTICE OF ERRORS IN PROPOSED ORDER OF PRESENTATION
 Attachment 2, page 32, places Intervenor Jason A. Howton at Link R1, with a "First Link"
designation of R1. Mr. Howton's Motion to Intervene (Item No. 1467) identifies his opposition
as Links F20 and F23. His property at 12808 FM 2843, Salado, Texas 76571 is located in the
Bell County corridor served by Link F20 and near F23. Link R1 is a route segment in far west
Texas. It has no connection to Mr. Howton's property or his stated grounds for intervention. The
placement appears to be a data-matching error. Every other Howton family member listed in

Attachment 2 is correctly placed in the F20 group. Mr. Howton should be placed in the F20
group, consistent with his Motion to Intervene and his docket registration.

B. Josh Bergbreiter Misplaced at Link V4

Attachment 2, page 34, places Intervenor Josh Bergbreiter (Item No. 2296) at Link V4, with
listed links of V4, V6, and V7. Mr. Bergbreiter's Motion to Intervene identifies his opposition as
Link F20. Links V4, V6, and V7 are in McCulloch County and bear no relation to Mr.
Bergbreiter's stated interest in the Bell County corridor. Mr. Bergbreiter should be placed in the
F20 group.
C. Stacy Randolph Misplaced at Link E13

Attachment 2, page 21, places Intervenor Stacy Randolph (Item No. 1462) at Link E13, with
listed links of E13. Ms. Randolph's Motion to Intervene identifies her opposition as Link F20.
Link E13 is near Salado but bears no relation to Ms. Randolph's stated interest in the Cedar
Valley corridor. Ms. Randolph should be placed in the F20 group.

                          III. ADDITIONAL APPARENT ERRORS

While reviewing Attachment 2 for accuracy, Mr. Howton identified additional placement errors
affecting other intervenors. He raises these as a courtesy to the presiding officers and notes that
those intervenors must speak for themselves regarding their own placements.




                     HOWTON NOTICE OF ERRORS IN PROPOSED ORDER OF PRESENTATION
 Verlon M. Tweedle's docket registration (Item No. 3875) lists Links F20, F21, F22, F23, and
G71. His testimony lists Links “F-20, F22, F23 and E13”. Attachment 2 places him at Link E13

with only E13 shown as his affected links, stripping all F-segment and G-segment opposition
from his entry. His wife, Georgia Tweedle (Item No. 3880), is placed at Link E13 but with F20,
F22, and F23 listed as supplemental links. Both appear to have been intended for placement in
the F22 group with adjacencies to F23 and F20 as their property sits as the intersection of all 3
links.

                                  IV. REQUEST FOR RELIEF

Mr. Howton respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges direct Applicants to
correct Attachment 2 to: (1) place Jason A. Howton in the F20 group consistent with Item No.
1467; (2) place Josh Bergbreiter in the F20 group consistent with Item No. 2296; (3) place Stacy
Randolph in the F20 group consistent with Item No. 1462; and (4) review the F20, F22, and F23
segment placements for accuracy and correct any additional errors identified by other parties or
by the presiding officers before the Hearing on the Merits commences on June 8, 2026.


Respectfully submitted,


/s/ Jason A. Howton
